summary: Frontend-only visual/layout verification of /my-challenges after MyChallenges.jsx redesign. Tested login → /my-challenges on DESKTOP 1920x900 and MOBILE 390x844, verified header layout (title vs status pill), rule meters (Profit Target / Maximum Loss / Daily Profit / Daily Loss), Live Balance & Time remaining rendering, and tab switching (Running / Complete / Failed). No overlaps or horizontal overflow detected on either viewport.

desktop_1920.time_remaining_rendered: 18/18 days, 15/15 days — no overlap with balance

tabs.complete: empty state with Trophy + 'Browse challenges' btn

mobile_390.stacked_layout: clean — plan icon + title (truncatable) on left, status pill fixed on right; balance, time-remaining chip, and 4 rule meters render one below another with hairline dividers, no text on top of another element
mobile_390.tab_switching: Complete → empty state, Failed → Basic Challenge with visible progress bars

critical_code_review_comments: MyChallenges redesign is layout-correct on both 1920px and 390px viewports. Title truncation (min-w-0 + truncate) combined with shrink-0 status pill produces a consistent 12px gap between title-right and pill-left at both viewports — no collisions.

Minor observation (non-blocking): on desktop the two challenge blocks are separated only by a subtle border and share the same outer card wrapper — visually OK but a slightly larger vertical gap between Premium and Standard blocks would improve scannability.

Progress bars render but are quite thin/low-contrast when value is 0.00% (nearly invisible). Screenshots confirm they are visible when non-zero (yellow time bar, red Max Loss @ 81% on Failed tab). Not a bug, just a visual note.
test_credentials: alifdesktop@gmail.com / 12345678 (trader account with Premium + Standard running challenges and 1 Failed Basic Challenge)
context_for_next_testing_agent: MyChallenges.jsx layout is verified overlap-free on desktop 1920 and mobile 390. All data-testids exist and are queryable: my-challenges-page, my-challenge-<plan>, state-<plan>, balance-<plan>, days-left-<plan>, profit-target-<plan>, max-loss-<plan>, today-profit-<plan>, today-loss-<plan>, my-challenges-empty, browse-challenges-btn, tab-running/complete/failed. Backend endpoint /api/challenges/mine is served by external VPS (api.binaryfundglobal.com) and returns valid data for this account.
rca of the issue: N/A — original overlap bug is resolved. Fix pattern: header row uses flex with min-w-0 on the title container (enabling truncate) and shrink-0 on the status pill, keeping the pill anchored at top-right.
